urlShortener.title: URL Shortener
urlShortener.brief: Design a system that takes a long URL and returns a short URL, redirecting millions of accesses per day.
urlShortener.constraint2: Reads >> writes (redirects are much more frequent)

socialFeed.title: Social Media Feed
socialFeed.brief: Design the backend of a Twitter/Instagram-style feed: users post, follow others, and see a chronological or ranked feed.
socialFeed.constraint1: Fan-out of posts to millions of followers
socialFeed.check1: API Gateway at the entry of requests
socialFeed.check6: CDN to serve media near the user

chatApp.title: Real-Time Chat
chatApp.brief: Design an instant messaging system for 1:1 and group messages, with reliable delivery and online/offline status.
chatApp.check3: Queue to guarantee delivery and ordering

ecommerce.title: E-commerce: Cart & Checkout
ecommerce.brief: Design the cart flow and checkout of a large-scale e-commerce platform, including payment and inventory.
ecommerce.constraint1: Strong consistency in payment and inventory

freeForm.title: Free Mode
freeForm.brief: No constraints — use the canvas to explore any architecture you want to draw.

challenges.footNote: The checklist is a self-assessment guide — check whether each piece makes sense for the scenario, not just whether it is present.

tutorial.skipConfirmMsg: You can restart this tutorial anytime by clicking the button in the top right.

step1.title: Component Library
step1.content: On the left, you'll find all the components you can use to design your system architecture. They're organized by category.

step2.title: Categories
step2.content: Browse components by category: Client (frontends), Network & Edge (CDNs, load balancers), Compute (servers), and Data (databases, caches).

step3.title: Drag & Drop
step3.content: Click and drag any component from the sidebar onto the canvas to start building your system design.

step4.title: Canvas Editor
step4.content: This is your diagram workspace. You can drag components, edit their labels, and organize them as you see fit.

step5.title: Connect Components
step5.content: Hover over a component to reveal a connection circle. Drag it to another component to create a connection and show data flow.

step6.title: Toolbar
step6.content: The toolbar at the top shows your component count, connection count, and provides export and language options.

step7.title: Export Your Design
step7.content: Click 'Export PNG' to download your system architecture diagram as an image.

step8.title: Training Mode
step8.content: On the right, you can select one of 5 training scenarios, each with specific constraints to solve.

step9.title: Pick a Challenge
step9.content: Each scenario (URL Shortener, Social Feed, Chat, E-commerce, etc.) teaches a different architecture pattern.

step10.title: Complete the Checklist
step10.content: The checklist helps guide you toward a complete system design. Check items off as you add the necessary components to solve the challenge.
